The variant with the highest iron content is NFA-F, whose composition the paper gives as LiNi0.8Fe0.15Al0.05O2[1]. At the high-rate step of the rate capability test, NFA-F kept a capacity of ≈81 mAh g^− 1[2], against ≈116 mAh g^− 1[3] for NFA-A at the same rate. Fig. 7[4]

Caveat: the formula given for the third variant in the final section reads LiNi0.8Fe1Al1O2[5], which does not balance and conflicts with the earlier formula for the same material, LiNi0.8Fe0.1Al0.1O2[6]. On the earlier composition, that variant would still have less iron than NFA-F.
